limitations: Browser file-picker transport was not exercised; AppTest 1.52 exposes file_uploader as an unsupported/unknown element. Upload parsing, validation, evaluation, missing-class AUC and UI feedback were exercised by injecting CSV bytes at that widget boundary.
No live Streamlit Community Cloud deployment or BITS Virtual Lab execution was performed by these tests.

notebook.method: All 12 code cells first executed sequentially by an in-process IPython InteractiveShell. The selected-model figure cell was then amended for portable explicit PNG display and re-executed once using its inputs recalculated from the saved pipeline and held-out CSV. stdout, stderr, and rich outputs were captured through IPython capture_output.
notebook.transport_caveat: Standard nbclient/Jupyter ZMQ kernel transport could not initialize because of the environment's local socket interface restriction. The notebook's actual Python execution was verified through IPython in one process instead; no permission escalation or network retry was used.
